description: This PHP file defines a class `Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Edit_Map` which extends `SugarView` to provide a custom map editing interface for markers within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to render an HTML page with embedded JavaScript for Google Maps API integration, allowing users to view and edit marker locations on a map.
